title: Prove an original-input collision for the fully rounded QQ16 F0
body:
## Summary

```text
2^512 original data sign patterns, identical zero workspace
  -> actual first F0 ADD at 53-bit precision
  -> identical complete 712-field state
  -> identical fully rounded native endpoint
```

Add `research/qq16-f0-whole-state-collision/`, a scoped proof and finite certificate. Original data L119 contains 512 independent signs; common L169 is 2^54. Every input is exactly representable. All 480 helpers and eight private fields start and finish zero. Exact original-input recovery from this common endpoint plus fixed-length metadata requires at least 512 retained bits.

This is not an accuracy-bound failure, an admitted caller/supplier, or a new kappa. It is distinct from PR3258's local B1 child-return bound, PR3294's conditional exact B1 prefix, PR3293's helper-frame return, and the concurrent mixed-arithmetic PR3067 precision-family investigation. The latter keeps native children exact; this package uses the fully rounded pair-first native reference and a different family and conclusion.

## Evidence

- **Before:** local-return and exact-prefix results leave fully rounded original-input whole-state reachability unproved. **After:** the original inputs coalesce at actual zero-based event 2, before any native child, so the deterministic suffix cannot distinguish them.
- All 26,099 native events are source-bound. Integer-dyadic and separately written binary64 arithmetic agree at every changed suffix cut and on all 364,544 complex endpoint amplitudes. Exact full-word controls preserve the two distinct constant-sign inputs; 55-bit precision distinguishes them at the first cut.
- Six behavioral groups pass normally and optimized, including 2,814 independent rational rounding comparisons, all 512 single-sign changes, actual ADD mutants, exact-ADD escape, every live source corruption, and helper/trace/endpoint omissions.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15 replay, optimized CPython 3.13.5 direct replay, Ruff 0.17.1, all 12 committed-byte comparisons, and a read-only Git-free committed export with no Git executable pass locally on Linux x86_64. Hosted checks remain separate and will be monitored on this exact head.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/qq16-f0-whole-state-collision
```

Publication head `ee83c1a46bdc82d33c6e57d53f3560ceb79d807a`; canonical base/refreshed main `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`, priority revision 6. All five live inputs are canonical-main files; cold CI needs no unrelated pending PR object. Refresh covers 348 open PRs, 2147 Discussion records and 2630 closed PR bodies at the 21:19 and 21:20 UTC refreshes with complete pagination. Arbitrary diffs and unpublished work are not exhausted. No human-directed Discussion post was made.

Credit Sricharan Vagvala's fully rounded evaluator and binary64 corroboration, Tekalign/PR3017's Gaussian vectors, Arham Tahir/PR3036/3067's distinct witnesses, Nick Petalas/PR3258/3293/2965, Ross Richardson/PR2999, Ali Romman and the retained QQ16/native/compiler lineage. Original bytes and attribution remain unchanged. Automated drafting and checking were used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

Open next questions ask whether an actual caller needs exact sign recovery and, if so, how it pays for retained information. Input copies, rounding transcripts or an adequate exact grid escape the counting premise. Full-cover/global entry admission, all-depth execution, physical routing/storage/restoration tariffs, F17 consumption, selected cold replay and full multiplication remain unproved or unrun.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in research package. No frozen-source, shared-checker, selected-frontier or production implementation change.
